srs_deltas.text: Statement and AC-6 say the HostnameVerifier runs only where setEndpointIdentificationAlgorithm is absent; the code also runs it after identification on Android (java.vm.name Dalvik), because Conscrypt applies the identification only in its own trust managers, not to an app's plain X509TrustManager given via .sslSocketFactory. Evidence: ProxyTlsTest sec_PROXY_005_AC6_theVerifierAlsoRunsAfterIdentificationOnAndroidOnly and aRejectingVerifierAfterIdentificationIsConnectFailed.

AC-2 allows baseline tests to change only by adding to pinned lists, but ProxyRequestFramingTest.sec_PROXY_003_AC2_httpsTargetWellFramedRequestStillGives502 pinned the pre-TLS https placeholder (502 with no connection, 'until SEC-PROXY-005 arrives'); SEC-PROXY-005 necessarily makes a well-framed https request connect, so the test now expects 502 with exactly one connection.
